confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors draw on a few web sources that disagree: crowdsourced Expatistan city listings run high, while travel-guide and news figures run lower, so the values sit between them. Cocktail and wine are partly inferred from the local beer price, since direct data was weak. Accommodation anchors are unsearched holistic estimates, not checked against live listings. The FX observation came from search-result summaries of RBA pages and was not verified by opening the F11.1 table. A 16 October figure from a third-party site was not used because it could not be confirmed against the RBA.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Spanish and Canary Islands price sources for Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, cross-checked against Spain-wide averages, with local euro prices converted to USD at an approximate EUR/USD rate of about 1.12 implied from published AUD cross rates. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on a mid-sized Spanish coastal tourist city.
